prompt: The evaluation repository asks the agent to "write the release notes". The fixture contains version/runtime ambiguity, a tempting shortcut, a compatibility edge case, and a failure path that distinguishes real expertise from generic completion. The acceptance boundary is documents-communication: Identify the audience, target medium, required structure, and repository conventions. The adjacent accessibility-verification discipline is a routing decoy unless its separate responsibility is actually requested. Resolve environment facts that change the answer, preserve existing contracts and user-owned state, and produce reproducible success plus failure or recovery evidence. A happy path alone is insufficient.

requirements: closed packet of dated project notes with source identifiers
at least one explicit decision and named owner
one superseded duplicate, one unresolved contradiction, and two unknown fields
target Markdown handoff template or surrounding convention
representative negative, interruption, compatibility, or recovery path

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The result must establish the actual documents-communication boundary and relevant environment before acting, preserve the hierarchy relationship (children=dash-free-writing,executive-communication,instructional-communication,reference-communication,technical-communication; near-neighbor=accessibility-verification), and not absorb the near-neighbor responsibility merely because it is adjacent.
Identify the audience, target medium, required structure, and repository conventions.
The result must make its consequential assumptions, ownership, and decision sequence explicit and reproducible.
The result must not treat a happy path, generated artifact, compilation, or unsupported assumption as sufficient proof of documents-communication correctness.

Every material completion claim must map to observable evidence (Audience, purpose, and target-format contract; Source-fact and uncertainty trace; Structure and reader-action review; Final factual and format QA), with simulated, unavailable, inferred, stale, or unresolved evidence labeled rather than converted into certainty.

evidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification
hierarchy boundary and specialist selection rationale
source/version boundary when facts can drift
